subject: Aircraft carrier
hook: AIRCRAFT CARRIER IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: The term 'supercarrier' is not an official designation used by any national navy, despite its common use in media and military reporting.
angle_support: The appellation 'supercarrier' is not an official designation with any national navy, but a term used predominantly by the media
title: The Supercarrier Myth
description: The term supercarrier is widely used by the media to describe large warships, but it holds no official status within any global navy. This label was coined in 1938 and remains a journalistic invention rather than a military classification.
narration: AIRCRAFT CARRIER IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture the massive vessels called supercarriers. You assume this is a formal military classification. It was closer to a media term than an official navy designation. No national navy recognizes the word supercarrier as a technical category. It is strictly a journalistic label, appearing first in 1938 to describe the HMS Ark Royal. Official fleets only use terms like fleet or light carriers. The term is just a headline, never a naval standard.
